replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
What motivated me to become a moderator?
Well thats actually quite an interesting question but basically the short version was that i actually wanted to start doing something for this community. So basically i just wanted to give back to the community and i decided that moderating would be the best way to do so as i am crap at making maps xD.

Is zeus better then Poseidon?
Being God of the sea/water/earthquakes/horses is definitely better then being a supreme god, so no. Poseidon is way better than Zeus.
